selection_scope: Existing 248 R10 candidates only; no new acquisition or license investigation.
execution_rule: Do not execute formal recall until 20 positives and 10 negatives are genuinely human verified and that completed fixture is committed before execution.
negative_rule: Human confirms no qualifying table; expected_extractable_groups=0, table-specific fields may be null with explanation.
recall_unit: Recovered canonical groups matched to human expected sample identities, not descriptor cells or panelists.
limitations: No human verification record has been supplied. Empty arrays are missing ground truth, not zero eligible papers. Even high recall on hand-selected controls does not independently establish population scarcity. Inverse recall is not a population supply estimator.
